title: Fix barcode scanner in admin billing with high-speed library and professional features

requirements.summary: Integrate a high-speed barcode scanning library (QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode) into the admin billing page to reliably recognize standard retail barcodes including EAN-13 and UPC formats
acceptanceCriteria: Barcode scanner successfully detects and decodes EAN-13 and UPC barcodes
Scanner uses one of the specified libraries (QuaggaJS, ZXing, or Html5-QRCode)
Scanning works reliably with standard retail product barcodes

file_operations.description: Create a professional barcode scanner component using QuaggaJS library for high-speed EAN-13 and UPC barcode recognition. Component should integrate with the camera/useCamera hook for camera access and provide callbacks for successful scans and errors. Include proper initialization, cleanup, and continuous scanning support. The component must handle camera permissions gracefully and provide a clear preview area for scanning.

Replace the existing basic camera-based barcode scanner with the new BarcodeScanner component. Remove manual barcode input camera logic and integrate the high-speed scanner. Ensure the scanner modal displays the BarcodeScanner component with proper dimensions and controls. Wire scanner success callbacks to trigger product lookup and addition to bill items.
Add QuaggaJS library dependency (@ericblade/quagga2) for high-speed barcode scanning with EAN-13 and UPC support. Include TypeScript type definitions if available.

requirements.summary: Enable auto-focus for the camera and add a Flash/Torch toggle button within the scanner UI to support scanning in low-light conditions
acceptanceCriteria: Camera uses auto-focus mode when available
UI includes a visible Flash/Torch toggle button
Flash/Torch can be turned on and off during scanning
Scanner works effectively in low-light environments when flash is enabled

file_operations.description: Add flash/torch toggle functionality to the BarcodeScanner component. Implement a visible toggle button in the scanner UI that enables/disables the device torch using MediaStreamTrack API. Configure camera constraints to request auto-focus capability when initializing the video stream. Include visual feedback for flash state (icon change or color indication). Handle devices that don't support torch gracefully by hiding or disabling the toggle.

Ensure the scanner modal layout accommodates the flash toggle button and provides sufficient space for scanner controls. Update camera configuration passed to BarcodeScanner to request auto-focus and environment-facing camera for optimal scanning.

requirements.summary: Implement instant product fetch: when a barcode is successfully scanned, automatically fetch the product name, price, and GST details from the database and add it to the billing list without requiring any manual clicks
acceptanceCriteria: Scanned barcode triggers immediate product lookup in the backend
Product with matching barcode is retrieved with name, price, and GST details
Product is automatically added to the billing list without user interaction
Entire flow happens seamlessly after scan recognition

file_operations.description: Implement automatic product fetch and addition flow in the barcode scan success callback. When BarcodeScanner detects a barcode, immediately call the backend getProductByBarcode method using the existing useQueries hook. Upon successful product retrieval, automatically add the product to billItems state with quantity 1 and calculate prices including GST (18% as per existing logic). Handle the complete flow without requiring manual confirmation or button clicks. Update UI to show loading state during fetch and provide feedback when product is added.

requirements.summary: Enable continuous scanning mode that allows the admin to scan multiple items one after another without closing the camera after each scan
acceptanceCriteria: Camera remains open after a successful scan
Admin can immediately scan another barcode without reopening the scanner
Scanner only closes when explicitly dismissed by the admin
Multiple products can be added in rapid succession

file_operations.description: Implement continuous scanning mode in BarcodeScanner component. After a successful barcode detection and callback execution, keep the camera stream active and QuaggaJS detection running instead of stopping. Add a small cooldown period (300-500ms) after each successful scan to prevent duplicate detections of the same barcode. Provide a visible 'Close' or 'Done' button that admin must click to stop scanning and close the camera.

Update scanner modal to support continuous scanning workflow. Remove automatic modal closure after successful scans. Keep isScannerOpen state true after product additions. Ensure the close button in the modal properly stops the camera and closes the scanner. Update UI to show brief feedback (like a flash or checkmark animation) after each successful scan while keeping scanner active.

requirements.summary: Add a beep sound notification that plays when a barcode is successfully scanned to provide audio feedback to the admin
acceptanceCriteria: Distinct beep sound plays immediately after successful scan
Sound provides clear confirmation without being disruptive
Audio feedback works consistently across scan sessions

file_operations.description: Add a short, pleasant beep sound file (MP3 format, ~0.5 seconds duration) to the public assets directory for barcode scan success audio feedback. The sound should be clear and professional, suitable for retail point-of-sale environments.

Add audio feedback capability to BarcodeScanner component. Create an Audio instance referencing the beep sound file at /assets/beep.mp3. Play the beep sound immediately after successful barcode detection and before triggering the onScan callback. Handle audio playback errors gracefully (e.g., if autoplay is blocked). Ensure sound plays consistently for each successful scan in continuous mode.

requirements.summary: Implement error handling that shows a quick popup with the message 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?' when a scanned barcode is not found in the database
acceptanceCriteria: Popup appears when barcode lookup returns no matching product
Popup displays the exact text 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?'
Popup provides clear visual feedback and is easy to dismiss
Scanner remains ready to scan next item after error handling

file_operations.description: Add error handling for barcode lookup failures in the scan callback. When getProductByBarcode returns null (product not found), display a toast notification or alert dialog with the exact message 'Product Not Found - Add Manually?'. Use the existing toast system (react-hot-toast) for consistency. Ensure the error message is brief (2-3 seconds) and doesn't interrupt continuous scanning. Scanner should remain active and ready for the next scan after showing the error.

requirements.summary: Update camera permission request description to: 'This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers'
acceptanceCriteria: Camera permission prompt shows the specified description
Description complies with app store requirements for permission justification

file_operations.description: Add a permission explanation UI that displays before requesting camera access. Show an information dialog or banner with the text 'This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers' when the user first opens the scanner or if permission was previously denied. This ensures users understand why camera access is needed before the browser permission prompt appears.

Add camera permission usage description meta tag for PWA compliance. Include <meta name="camera-usage-description" content="This app requires camera access for the Admin Billing Panel to scan product barcodes, ensuring fast and error-free billing for customers" /> to satisfy app store requirements for permission justification when the PWA is installed.
